_scope: Hills has almost no testable surface today, and this config says so rather
than hiding it behind a flattering number.
Unlike helios and hyperspace it carries no shared C++ core -- its logic is
Objective-C under 'Source Code', and all of it is either GL-coupled
(HeightField, Scene, SkyDome, HillsOpenGLView, MainController) or Cocoa UI
Camera.m is the one unit that is mostly arithmetic; it still includes
<OpenGL/glu.h> for a single gluLookAt in -apply, so OpenGL is linked and
any test must stay off that method until the port replaces it.
This list should grow as hills is ported.
